description: Padacioso's deterministic, regex-based template matcher takes the first shot and extracts slots from an exact match; Nebulento's fuzzy string matching mops up anything the strict templates miss. Both engines are training-free and dependency-light, making this the lightweight padatious replacement candidate for installs where model2vec is not available.
notes: HYPOTHESIS: Padacioso's high-confidence exact template gate plus Nebulento's fuzzy fallback should catch both exact and near-miss phrasings without any training step, unlike padatious or m2v-based fighters which need a trained model. Nebulento runs at its own low-confidence gate (conf_low) rather than medium so it actually fires as a fallback instead of sitting nearly silent behind Padacioso's high gate; conf_high/conf_med/conf_low values are copied verbatim from the single-engine nebulento-medium template fighter, only the pipeline tier differs.
